message:
Q: Do we have to invite everyone who got a save-the-date?

A: Yes. A save-the-date is a promise, so everyone who receives one must also receive an invitation. Finalize your core guest list before you send them.

More on save-the-dates vs. invitations:
https://bridalteam.com/guides/save-the-dates-vs-invitations?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-02-eve-save-the-date-promise
